description: Pinned Setup title, step and progress (REQ-025; C52, G17, R24; AC-C52-01, AC-R025-01; JOURNEY-025). A3 TASK-113 (Round 7, accepted gallery bec44545eb982f6dc136a583400f7e314c306d1d): on the real Setup / onboarding equipment screen (/onboarding, reached through the existing auth and onboarding guards) Set up CLEAR is the title of Round 7's setup header (AppHeader with clr-setup-header) and Round 7's setup progress (clr-setup-progress: the shared Progress, a named visible progressbar 'Step N of 5') is Screen's pinnedHead under it: one pinned head closed by one full-width divider - the shared Screen has the header hand its own rule to the head when a pinned layer joins it (src/app/Screen.tsx) - with the scroller starting at that divider, so the equipment list scrolls below it and never under it. No bespoke sticky overlay, no second divider, no hidden progress; every equipment choice takes keyboard focus in view below the head and above the pinned footer; touch, reduced motion, a reopen, the step controls and a failed commit (said, draft kept, retry sends the same draft) keep the pinned head. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=screens draws Setup as a static composition (its header with the label Setup and the step line 'Step 1 of 5 · Equipment' over a scrolling body), read in the same way: title and step line pinned over one divider, the content starting at it, nothing read or written; the route is compared with it in e2e/refinement/task-113-parity.spec.ts. The build's wrapper (.clr-screen__pinned) and its gallery part drawn from the route's SetupProgress are retired. check-01 proves it in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session; every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-025 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-025.spec.ts --project=mobile
